description: An accounting firm has senior accountants earning SeniorWage per week and junior accountants earning JuniorWage per week. The contracts with companies to provide accounting services require at least MinTotalAccountants accountants, of whom at least MinSeniorAccountants must be senior accountants. To make sure there is enough experience on the accounting team, the number of senior accountants should be at least one third of the number of junior accountants. The firm wants to keep the weekly wage bill below WageBillLimit. Formulate an LP to minimize the wage bill.

SeniorWage.definition: Weekly wage of a senior accountant

JuniorWage.definition: Weekly wage of a junior accountant

MinTotalAccountants.definition: Minimum total number of accountants required

MinSeniorAccountants.definition: Minimum number of senior accountants required

SeniorToJuniorRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of senior to junior accountants

objective.description: "Minimize the total weekly wage bill for senior and junior accountants"

constraints.description: The total number of accountants (senior + junior) must be at least MinTotalAccountants
The number of senior accountants must be at least MinSeniorAccountants
The number of senior accountants must be at least SeniorToJuniorRatio times the number of junior accountants
The total weekly wage bill (SeniorWage * number of senior accountants + JuniorWage * number of junior accountants) must not exceed WageBillLimit
The number of senior and junior accountants must be non-negative
